offline.keep: Keep the whole dictionary on this device (about {mb} MB)
offline.keepNoSize: Keep the whole dictionary on this device
offline.kept: The whole dictionary is kept on this device, since {date} ({mb} MB).
offline.notPersisted: The browser has not promised to keep it: if the device runs short of space, it may clear it. Installing Ordpar as an app usually helps.
offline.noteUpdated: Ordpar has been updated — reload to see it

offline.persisted: The browser has agreed to keep it (persistent storage).

offline.updateFailed: The last update failed ({error}); the copy you have still works.

recent.label: Recent searches
recent.title: Recent
results.empty: Type a Norwegian word to search the dictionary.
results.noneWhy: It may be a compound (Norwegian builds them without limit), a misspelling, or an article whose translation we have not reached yet — every Bokmål article is on this site, in Norwegian where the English is not authored.
search.label: Search a Norwegian word
search.suggestionsHint: {n} suggestions. Use the arrow keys to choose one.
search.tooManyWords: That looks like a sentence — search one word at a time.
search.wordTooLong: That word is too long to be a headword.
settings.applied: Changes apply at once and are kept in this browser.
settings.defs.en.note: The shortest articles, for when you only need the meaning.
settings.defs.no: Norwegian, with the English hidden until revealed
settings.defs.no.note: For when you mostly follow the Norwegian: the English stays hidden until you need it.
settings.emph.en.note: Example sentences keep the Norwegian emphasized.
settings.examples.no: Norwegian, with the English hidden until revealed
settings.examples.no.note: For practising your Norwegian: read the example first, then reveal the English to check yourself.
settings.exlimit.hint: Fewer examples make a long article quicker to skim. Each sense and subsense shows its first examples, in the article's order, our added ones (+) included. With a number chosen, the setting below decides whether the rest can still be opened.
settings.exmore: The line to show the rest
settings.exmore.hint: On: under a sense whose examples were cut, a line such as "Show 12 more examples" opens the rest in place. Off: the rest are not shown.
settings.formulas: Short formula lines, such as "used as an adverb:"
settings.formulas.both.note: The labels of compound lists stay in English.
settings.formulas.no.note: The labels of compound lists are in Norwegian too.
settings.infl.open.note: Handy when you are working on the forms. The articles get longer.
settings.layout.ordbokene.note: Familiar if you use ordbokene.no. An "Example" heading over each sense's examples, and the examples set flush under it.
settings.listview.multi: Only when there are several articles
settings.minicontent.full: Each sense in full, with a few examples
settings.minicontent.slim.note: Leaves out most subsenses and lists of compounds. Open the whole article for them.
settings.minifetch: When a linked article or page is loaded
settings.minifetch.click.note: Uses the least data: nothing is loaded before you click. An article can take a moment to open the first time.
settings.minifetch.hint: Loading ahead makes articles open faster, but uses data for articles you never open. With the offline copy downloaded, articles come from the copy, so no data is used either way.
settings.minifetch.page.note: The fastest on a phone, which has no pointer to rest on. Uses the most data, since every linked article comes whether you open it or not. With the browser's data saver on, only when the link is clicked.
settings.minifetch.point: When the pointer rests on its link
settings.minifetch.point.note: Articles open almost at once on a computer. Uses a little extra data for links you rest on but don't click. On a touch screen, the article starts loading when you touch the link.
settings.minihw.article.note: It is still a link: click it to open the whole article.
settings.miniscroll: A tall one on a computer
settings.minitext.smaller.note: A step smaller than the article, so more of a long small article fits in its box.
settings.noscript: The settings need JavaScript: they are kept in this browser's storage.
settings.peek.off.note: Fewer pop-ups while you read. A click still opens the link.
settings.pframes.hint: In the inflection tables, grey words beside the perfect participle forms: "+ noun" after each, and "den/det" before the definite form. Not in the narrow tables.
settings.stats.hint: Off: this browser sends none of the messages the Privacy page describes (page views, searches, suggestions chosen and installs). "Delete stored data" turns it back on.
settings.stored: Everything here is stored on this device only, and none of it is sent anywhere. No cookies, no accounts.
settings.subsenses.en.note: Shorter articles to scan. When the definitions show both languages. Short formula lines keep their own setting.
settings.title: Settings
settings.xref.mini: Open as a small article on the page

transfer.parse: This file could not be read: it is not an Ordpar export. Nothing was changed.

transfer.storage: The browser would not store the import (its storage is full or blocked). Nothing was changed.
transfer.title: Move to another device
transfer.version: This file comes from a newer version of Ordpar and cannot be read here. Nothing was changed.
